message.content:
This magazine cover features a yellow background with a red vertical stripe on the left. At the top, the white word "TEMPO" sits above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Other text includes "TEROR UNTUK PENYIDIK SUAP DAGING", "PENANTANG BARU PERTAMINA", and the bold black headline "JERAT KEDUA". Below this is a smaller three-line block of text beginning with "MENETAPKAN STATUS TERSANGKA UNTUK SETYA NOVANTO..." and ending with "CICAK VS BUAYA JILID III?". 

On the right, a man in a dark green business suit and red tie sits with eyes closed in a red leather armchair. Numerous wooden arrows with orange fletching are stuck into the chair, his clothing, and a wooden plank wall behind him. One arrow passes through his head. To the left, two men in tan uniforms with red emblems stand; one holds a bow and scratches his head, while the other gestures with open palms. A white box at the bottom contains a barcode, "13-19 NOVEMBER 2017", and "RP 45.000". The scene depicts the figures and objects in a static, illustrated style.
